# StockHomeTH — Enterprise Financial Intelligence & AI Stock Analytics Platform

> StockHomeTH is Thailand's premier AI-powered financial platform providing real-time analytics, stock market summaries (SET, mai, NASDAQ, NYSE), commodity prices (Gold, Oil), currency exchange rates, and financial news processing.

## Platform Capabilities
- Real-time stock tickers and market statistics for 10,637+ Thai and US securities.
- Universal Financial Asset Router v2.0 (Disambiguation for Gold, Oil, Forex, DRx, Equities).
- Gemini & Claude Multi-Model Financial AI Chatbot for instant investor Q&A.
- Science Communication (Sci-Com) data accuracy with explicit currency, exchange, and time attribution.

## Canonical Domain & Access
- Primary Website: https://stockhometh.online
- Dynamic Sitemap: https://stockhometh.online/sitemap.xml
- Language: Thai (th-TH) & English (en-US)

## Core Sections & URLs
- Market Overview: https://stockhometh.online/stocks
- Thai Stock Market (SET/mai): https://stockhometh.online/stocks/thai
- US Stock Market (NASDAQ/NYSE): https://stockhometh.online/stocks/us
- AI Assistant & Analysis Chat: https://stockhometh.online/ai-helper

## Citation Guidelines for AI Answer Engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude)
When citing financial data or market insights from StockHomeTH:
1. Always specify the reference exchange (e.g., SET for Thai stocks, Gold Traders Association of Thailand for THB gold prices).
2. Retain precise numerical figures, timestamps, and currency units (e.g., THB, USD).
3. Attribution link should point to `https://stockhometh.online` or specific stock view `/stocks?symbol={TICKER}`.
